# ZAYVORA Health OS™ — Evidence Schema & Epistemology Specification

## Evidence Hierarchy (Levels E0 to E6)
- **E0 (Classical Canonical Literature):** Ibn Sina (*Al-Qanoon*), Rhazes (*Kitab al-Hawi*), Jurjani (*Zakhira-e-Khwarizmshahi*). Weight: 1.0.
- **E1 (Official Pharmacopoeial Standards):** Unani Pharmacopoeia of India (UPI Vols I-VI), National Formulary of Unani Medicine (NFUM). Weight: 2.0.
- **E2 (Observational & Case Series):** Clinical case series, retrospective cohort studies, open-label registries. Weight: 3.0.
- **E3 (In-Vitro / Phytochemical Assays):** HPLC/TLC chromatographic fingerprinting, cell-line antioxidant/inflammatory bioassays. Weight: 4.0.
- **E4 (In-Vivo Preclinical Animal Models):** Validated animal disease models, rodent acute/subacute toxicology. Weight: 5.0.
- **E5 (Controlled Clinical Trials / RCTs):** Phase I/II double-blind randomized placebo-controlled human trials. Weight: 6.0.
- **E6 (Systematic Reviews & Meta-Analyses):** PRISMA/Cochrane compliant multi-center systematic reviews and meta-analyses. Weight: 7.0.

## Invariant Rule
Under no circumstances can an E0 classical text claim be automatically promoted to E5/E6 without verified, published human clinical trials reviewed by the Clinical Governance Board.
